research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Based on titles and abstracts, HashiCorp is researching infrastructure as code and cloud infrastructure management through systems and methods for managing multi component multi deployment environments, lifecycle management for information technology infrastructure, provider defined functions for an infrastructure as code workflow, and ticket based provisioning. They also develop discovery and routing service for a cloud infrastructure and routing visualization user interface, plus secure access via zero trust multi hop authentication and authorization and cloud based secrets management credential store. Together these efforts target infrastructure automation, cloud routing, and identity centric security.

overview_description.description: HashiCorp is an open-source software company based in San Francisco, California. HashiCorp provides open source tools and commercial products that enable developers, operators, and security professionals to provide secure and run distributed application infrastructure. It was founded in 2012 by Mitchell Hashimoto and Armon Dadgar.

about_short_description.short_description: HashiCorp is a remote-first company that solves development, security, and operations challenges in infrastructure.

product.name: HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
product.description: A SaaS platform for managing HashiCorp infrastructure and security products across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

product.name: Terraform
product.description: Infrastructure-as-code software for provisioning and managing cloud, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure through a common workflow.

product.name: Vault
product.description: Identity-based secrets management software for storing, controlling, rotating, and accessing sensitive data and credentials.

product.name: Consul
product.description: Service networking software that provides service discovery, health checking, traffic management, and secure connectivity across distributed environments.

product.name: Boundary
product.description: Identity-based secure remote access software for connecting users to infrastructure without exposing network credentials or requiring broad network access.

product.name: Packer
product.description: Image-as-code software for building consistent machine and container images across cloud, virtualization, and on-premises environments.
